config.baseline_status: w2 (fixed 2 s, seg-v1) is a provisional, reversible default, NOT a proven optimum

limitations: Cross-strategy SEGMENT-level Recall is not directly comparable: candidate pools (26-93 units) and per-query relevant-unit counts differ by strategy and by temporal policy. Use FILE-grouped recall for file-retrieval comparisons.
Tolerance bridges adjacent-segment seams on seam-aligned policies (e.g. halves), inflating tolerant relevant counts vs strict; both counts are reported per query.
n=11 video queries (wide confidence intervals), synthetic hard-cut/static clips only; timings are single-run smoke readings, not p95.
